title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition

quotes.text: Do you get to the Cloud District very often? Oh, what am I saying—of course you don't.
I am sworn to carry your burdens.
Zu'u unslaad! Zu'u nis oblaan! ("I am eternal! I cannot be killed!")
M'aiq once walked to High Hrothgar. So many steps, he lost count.
A giant's power attack can launch you hundreds of feet skyward — a physics quirk Bethesda never fully patched.
Bethesda's E3 joke about a Skyrim game for Amazon Alexa turned out to be real. You can still play it by voice.
Every player swears they'll be a mage this time. Most end up a stealth archer within the hour.
You will carry forty unenchanted iron daggers to sell later. You never sell them.

notes: appid 489830 is the base game confirmed via Steam appdetails (type=game, matches Steam's official title verbatim). Note the Steam listing now describes itself as the 'Anniversary Edition' bundle in its storefront copy (Creation Club content included), but the appid/title/developer are unchanged from the original Special Edition base game — this is still the correct entry, not a separate SKU. Screenshot URLs had their '?t=...' cache-busting query params stripped since they are not required for the images to load; at least two verified HTTP 200. The Alduin quote uses in-game Dragon language with the game's own subtitle translation in parentheses, since the raw phrase alone isn't recognizable to most players.
